description: This Java class, AdbMessage, encapsulates the creation, manipulation, and transmission of ADB (Android Debug Bridge) protocol command packets. It provides methods for setting command headers, retrieving command details, and communicating with USB devices using Android's USB host APIs.

classes.name: AdbMessage
classes.description: Represents an ADB protocol message with functionality for constructing, sending, and parsing command packets.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the command header fields and optional data payload for the ADB message.

methods.name: getArg0
methods.description: Returns the first argument of the command.

methods.name: getArg1
methods.description: Returns the second argument of the command.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Returns the data buffer associated with the message.

methods.name: getDataLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the data payload.

methods.name: getDataString
methods.description: Returns the data payload as a string, trimmed of trailing zero.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Queues the message (and data if any) for transmission to the USB device.

methods.name: readCommand
methods.description: Queues a request to read the command header from the USB device.

methods.name: readData
methods.description: Queues a request to read data payload of specified length from the USB device.

methods.name: extractString
methods.description: Extracts a string from a ByteBuffer at a given offset and length.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the AdbMessage, including command name, args, and data.

methods.name: checksum
methods.description: Calculates a checksum of the given byte array for data integrity.
